setup.listingHint: Save it with what you do, your price and your area, then choose Activate in its ⋯ menu so customers can find it.

guide.listingTitleText: Name it the way clients search for it, such as “Home cleaning” or “Logo design”.
guide.listingCategoryText: Puts your service where clients look on the portal. Jobs posted in this category can reach you as leads.
guide.listingProviderText: Pick yourself, or the person on your team who does this work. New orders for it go to them.
guide.listingPriceText: For the whole job or per hour, as you choose under Pricing type. The listing needs a price before it can go live.
guide.listingAreaText: For work at the client's place, put a pin on the map where you start from and say how far you travel. Jobs inside that area reach you as leads.

tour.listings: Your services. A new listing starts as a draft: open it and choose “Activate” in its menu so clients can find and order it.
tour.leads: Jobs clients posted on the portal that fit your services and your area. Send a quote, or decline.
tour.taskboard: Every open job on the portal, not only the ones that fit your listings. You can send a quote on any of them.
tour.bids: The quotes you've sent. When a client accepts one, it becomes an order.
tour.orders: Work clients ordered from you, or gave you by accepting your quote. Their payment is held safely until they accept your work.
